notes.title: Update Notes July 8
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!
Here is the patch notes:

Changes


AI has been improved.
AI death animations improved.
Car camera has been improved.
Subtitles has been improved and made bigger.


New Additions


New hit sounds has been added.
You can now change controls.
Added new indicators to the tutorial to make some moves more understandable.


Fixes


Fixed a bug where car sometimes does spawn.
Fixed some audio distortions.
And small bug fixes.

Hold on! 
It's not finished yet.
We are working on new maps for the final part of the game and a new game mode that is purely based on action.
You will see the details soon!
